caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a sideboard or console table, with four slender, tapered legs. The top of the table is rectangular but curves outward at the front center. The table features three drawers on the front face: a long central drawer positioned above two smaller drawers that flank a larger, central lower drawer. Each drawer is adorned with round, brass or brass-colored handles. The wood is depicted in varying shades of brown, with the drawer fronts and trim being a lighter, slightly golden brown, in contrast to the darker reddish-brown top, sides, and legs. The legs are straight and narrow, and the apron beneath the drawers has a curved cutout shape in the center. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Dressing Table
